samples.subject: Biology - Photosynthesis
groundTruthLines: Chlorophyll pigments absorb blue and red light spectrums.
Light energy splits water molecules producing oxygen and protons.
ATP and NADPH are synthesized during the light-dependent reactions.
Carbon dioxide fixation occurs during the Calvin cycle in the stroma.
Enzyme RuBisCO catalyzes the initial carbon capture step.
Glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate is converted into glucose carbohydrates.

samples.subject: Computer Science - Algorithms
groundTruthLines: Binary search requires a sorted array with random access.
The search interval is halved on each comparison step.
Worst-case and average-case time complexity is O(log n).
Space complexity for iterative binary search is O(1).
Recursive implementations consume O(log n) call stack frames.
Edge case integer overflow: calculate mid as low + (high - low) / 2.
